top_choice_rationale: P001 rewards a mature, fully validated discovery chain: proglucagon processing, identification of the active GLP-1(7-36) peptide, incretin physiology and receptor biology, and long-acting agonists with independent randomized outcome data in diabetes, obesity, cardiovascular and renal disease. The Drucker, Holst and Mojsov allocation respects the three-person limit and the priority of discovery, and the citation links the physiology to incretin-based therapies without naming a drug developer. No award is clearly inferior given this strength of evidence.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile; my documented collaborations (Linnarsson, Frisen, Burge's group) involve no one credited in P001
